title: Don’t click links, download, or copy people’s trading bot code/prompts unless you enjoy getting your info/money stolen
author: BagNo7834
selftext:
With all of the posts and comments here showing a general interest in AI trading, yet a profound lack of experience, it’s worth mentioning that subs/forums like this are a playground for people with bad intent.

Think about it: Prompt injection is a thing. Trading bots are literally connecting to real money accounts. People are vibe coding with no idea how the infrastructure works.

Don’t give these people a back door into your trading account, local system, etc. by blindly following a stranger’s instructions.

AI trading is not an infinite money hack. Expect to spend time, money, and do research. Before you build something, think “what safety parameters should I have in place,” and keep that in mind as you go.

Good luck, stay safe.

comments.author: No-Inevitable6869
comments.body:
I agree completely. If you have a successful trading bot then why would you share it? 

It’s the same with YouTube strategies but bots come with an extra layer of risk as you stated.
